title: How is Claude's View only set on a Mac?
recommendation: The Allow Claude switch gets three settings: Off, View only (screenshots and lists, no input) and Control; it is the only way Claude's session is set to view only
body: D-5 says View only blocks Claude, but View only today is set per device by a message from the web page, which Claude's API session never sends. Options: three settings on the switch · a separate Claude: view only checkbox · no view only for Claude.
